ARM-7 specification

Payload

SPEC: ARM-7 payload is 5 kg at the flange. The figure applies to the standard gripper and to the calibrated home orientation of the arm; heavier tooling reduces the usable payload proportionally, and the lab records every tool mass in the fixture register.

Motion

SPEC: ARM-7 full speed is 2 m/s at the flange. Full speed is only reachable in automatic mode with the guard closed; in manual mode the controller limits the arm to a tenth of that, which is why demonstrations are always recorded in automatic mode.

Demonstration

DEMO: ARM-7 pick and place demo moves a 2 kg block. The demonstration script homes the arm, picks the block from station A, places it on station B and returns; the expected result is the block resting centred on station B with the gripper open.
